en.p: There is a cubic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient 1 that has a local maximum value 8 at $x=3$. For a real number $t$, let the function $g(x)$ be

and let $h(t)$ be the number of distinct real roots of the equation $g(x)=0$. When there are exactly two values of $a$ at which the function $h(t)$ is discontinuous at $t=a$, find the value of $f(8)$. [4 points]
